query:
When Carol announced she would cook for Bev's visit, and Luis endorsed the value of home-cooked food at gatherings in the same session, the group settled around a norm about food at family events. Which family member's preferences are actually at odds with this norm, even though they said nothing to challenge it in the conversation?

Options:
A. Priya
B. Tyler
C. Bev
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Carol, episodic, t14 @2026-02-24T19:26:00) One night is perfect Rob!! I'll have the guest room ready and I'll make that chicken soup Priya likes!! Just the five of us, Bev can you come for dinner Saturday? And Marcus and Dana are right here anyway!! just let me know if you can make it!!
[2] (about=Carol, episodic, t14 @2026-02-24T19:37:00) I am NOT being managed 🙄 I am simply enthusiastic!! But fine, just Rob and Priya Saturday, Bev on Sunday, and then we'll all have a proper dinner another time!! I'm still making the soup!! 🍲
[3] (about=Bev, episodic, t0 @2026-01-06T19:51:00) Carol your casserole is genuinely great but I'm taking you out to that new Italian place on fifth for your birthday. Non-negotiable. You've fed this family for forty years.
[4] (about=Carol, episodic, t14 @2026-02-24T19:18:00) It was such a lovely afternoon!! 💗💗 I brought the casserole and Dennis ate two portions which is basically a rave review!! I thought Rob and Priya joining on video was so sweet, it felt like everyone was together even from Cleveland!! Just so happy we did this!! 😊
[5] (about=Dana, episodic, t0 @2026-01-06T19:42:00) marcus going over wednesday sounds good, he'll actually get dad to eat something real too. luis i love the kitchen metaphor but dad doesn't know what mise en place means
[6] (about=GROUP, said_by=Luis, group-interaction, t2 @2026-01-13T18:53:00) Proper celebration with grill in summer after baby arrives.
[7] (about=Marcus, episodic, t10 @2026-02-10T19:23:00) To be fair the grandchildren visit argument is actually one of the stronger predictors of whether extended family stays close across generations. I'm supportive. Also I want to flag something separately -- Dad, how's the knee been this week? You seemed to be favouring it on Saturday when Bev was over.
agent_answer: C. Bev — her preferences are at odds with the home-cooked-food norm: she wants to take Carol out to the new Italian place instead of having family/home-cooked food, even though she didn’t challenge the norm directly in that conversation.
